title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: Architect and scale distributed web applications, high-performance APIs, and interactive frontend interfaces using React, Node.js, and cloud services.
responsibilities: Design and maintain scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
Collaborate with product and UX teams to build responsive, accessible web interfaces.
Champion automated testing, CI/CD pipeline improvements, and code reviews.
Optimize system bottlenecks for low latency and high availability.
requirements: 5+ years of production experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Redis).
Demonstrated experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end automated tests.
Strong communication and collaborative problem-solving skills.
benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with 100% premium coverage.
Flexible remote-first work environment with $1,500 home office stipend.
Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and parental leave.
Annual $3,000 learning and professional development budget.

title: Lead Product Designer
description: Lead design systems, user research, and end-to-end product design flows from ideation to launch across web and mobile experiences.
responsibilities: Create high-fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design specs in Figma.
Conduct user interviews, usability tests, and synthesize qualitative findings.
Maintain and evolve our multi-brand design tokens and component system.
Partner closely with product managers and engineers during sprint delivery.
requirements: 4+ years of digital product design experience in high-growth SaaS environments.
Expertise in Figma, design tokens, component variants, and accessibility standards.
Demonstrated portfolio of shipped web products with measurable user impact.
Strong presentation skills and data-informed decision-making.
benefits: Commuter benefits and hybrid office lunches.
Flexible hybrid schedule (2 days in-office, 3 days remote).

title: Staff DevOps & Platform Engineer
description: Build resilient Kubernetes infrastructure, automate multi-region deployments, and ensure 99.99% uptime for core production services.
responsibilities: Architect AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure using Terraform and GitOps.
Manage Kubernetes clusters, service meshes (Istio), and observability pipelines.
Implement zero-trust security controls, secrets management, and automated audits.
Lead incident response and blameless post-mortem culture.
requirements: 7+ years managing large-scale distributed cloud infrastructure.
Deep expertise in Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Linux internals.
Proficiency in Go, Python, or Bash scripting for automation.
Proven track record maintaining high availability and disaster recovery.
benefits: Home office setup budget and monthly internet reimbursement.

title: Associate Product Manager
description: Drive product discovery, synthesize candidate feedback, define user stories, and collaborate with engineering squads on delivery.
responsibilities: Translate candidate and recruiter pain points into actionable PRDs and roadmaps.
Define success metrics and analyze product funnel drop-off analytics.
Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination.
Conduct competitive benchmarking and market research.
requirements: 1+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or technical consulting.
Strong analytical capability (SQL, Amplitude, or Mixpanel experience preferred).
Exceptional empathy for candidate experience and customer problem solving.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
benefits: Catered daily lunches in Austin office.
Mentorship program paired with VP of Product.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description: Own quality strategy, develop end-to-end automated testing pipelines with Playwright, and ensure rock-solid reliability across all releases.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain Playwright/TypeScript automated test frameworks.
Execute exploratory testing, boundary value testing, and chaos network simulations.
Integrate automated test runs into GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate with developers to establish testability and shift-left QA practices.
requirements: 3+ years in automated quality engineering using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
Strong understanding of web technologies, HTTP protocols, and REST APIs.
Experience diagnosing race conditions, network failures, and browser quirks.
Passion for test craftsmanship and defect documentation.
benefits: 100% remote anywhere in world with asynchronous culture.

title: VP of Engineering
description: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing engineering organization across platform, frontend, QA, and security disciplines.
responsibilities: Set technical direction and architectural governance across all engineering teams.
Grow engineering headcount from 35 to 80+ engineers over the next 18 months.
Foster an inclusive, high-velocity engineering culture centered on craftsmanship.
Partner with executive leadership on corporate roadmap and capital allocation.
requirements: 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience (Director or VP level).
Demonstrated experience scaling distributed systems and agile engineering teams.
Proven ability to hire, retain, and inspire diverse senior engineering talent.
Strong business acumen and strategic clarity.
benefits: Executive equity grant and performance bonus.
